name: Jim Corbett National Park
tagline: India's Premier Tiger Reserve & Wild Wilderness
description: Famed for its majestic Bengal tigers, dense sal forests, and tranquil rivers, Jim Corbett is India's oldest national park and an unmatched nature sanctuary.

name: Ranthambore National Park
tagline: Royal Tigers Amidst Ancient Forts & Ruins
description: A legendary wildlife haven where royal Bengal tigers roam freely among the historic ruins of the 10th-century Ranthambore Fort and serene lakes.

name: Nainital
tagline: The Enchanting City of Lakes in the Kumaon Hills
description: Set in a steep valley around the eye-shaped Naini Lake, Nainital is one of India's most cherished hill stations with colonial charm and panoramic mountain views.

name: Bhimtal
description: Larger and calmer than Nainital, Bhimtal features a picturesque lake with an island aquarium in the center, surrounded by pine forests and scenic walking trails.
bestTime: March to June & September to December

name: Mukteshwar
description: Perched high in the Kumaon hills, Mukteshwar offers 180-degree views of the snow-capped Himalayan peaks, fruit orchards, and colonial heritage tranquility.
bestTime: March to June & October to February
